title: Brazil — HCCH 1961 competent authorities (world index, needs review)

authorities.name: Legal, notarial and registration authorities
authorities.source_name: Pursuant to Article 6 of the Convention, the Government of the Federative Republic of Brazil states that, according to the applicable Brazilian legislation, the Judiciary is responsible for supervising and regulating notarial activities in Brazil. Therefore, legal, notarial and registration authorities will have competence to issue certificates by the Brazilian Government.
